scope: Proposition 2.4 (Closed stable surfaces) of the manuscript “Spectral scalar curvature and Urysohn width in dimension three” (preprints/Spectral-scalar-curvature-and-Urysohn-width-in-dimension-three-October-5-2026/spectral-urysohn-three-manifolds.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 336 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2a0852ff04d11752), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Σ be a smooth closed connected two-sided surface in a Riemannian three-manifold (X, h). Let T, µ be smooth ambient functions. Suppose that Σ satisfies H − νT = µ, is stable for weighted area with pressure µ, and satisfies (2.10) for a constant c > 0. Then, in the induced metric k = h|Σ, diamk Σ ≤ 2π √ c . Moreover, Σ is diffeomorphic to S2 or RP2.
